title: The Fish's Eye
style_lock: Charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; warm cream-saffron-gold hour; soft faces; clear silhouettes
frame: Ornate lotus / peony carved wooden frame on every plate

apparatus.target: Live fish swimming inside a large circular ornamental sealed glass aquarium filled with water; flat bottom, elegant gold/bronze rim
apparatus.mount: Chandelier-style suspension from the high palace ceiling medallion via slender gold chains only — open air around the tank
apparatus.height: TRUE CEILING HEIGHT: aquarium hangs under the palace roof, far above any standing person. In composition: near the top of the frame, long chains visible, people small relative to hall height. Never mid-hall or eye-level.
apparatus.mirror: Circular still water pool set into the stone floor directly below; clear reflection of the distant high aquarium

aim_geometry.eyes: Look DOWN at the floor pool reflection only — chin/gaze toward water; pool is the optical mirror
aim_geometry.arrow: Arms and arrow aimed UPWARD / steeply up at the ceiling aquarium — the real target is high above
forbidden: Looking up at the fish with direct eyes
Arrow aimed into the pool as if reflection were physical target
Aquarium at archer head/chest height filling mid-frame

apparatus.task: Hit the eye of the real fish in the ceiling-high aquarium while looking only at the reflection in the floor pool
forbidden: Dry metal fish on a pole
Fish only in the floor pool as the target
Wooden cradle or box holding the aquarium
Heavy horizontal wooden beams obstructing the aquarium
Aquarium at human eye / chest / mid-hall height
Archer looking up at the tank
Arrow aimed down into the pool
apparatus.size: LARGE ceiling disc matching challenge plate: wide gold-rimmed ornamental sealed aquarium spanning a large fraction of the roof opening — NOT a small pot, jar, or fishbowl. Same dimensions on every fish panel.
